name: RoulettePotV2
fix_description: In getTokenAmountForLink, replace router.getAmountsOut (spot AMM price) with a TWAP oracle or Chainlink price feed. The current implementation reads instantaneous pool reserves which can be manipulated via flash loan.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is short, but the exploit is a multi-step DeFi flow combining a PancakeV3 flash loan, PancakeSwap pair manipulation, and two protocol-specific calls to the vulnerable contract. An auditor would need to understand how temporary reserve/balance distortion affects RoulettePotV2’s accounting, so it is more than a trivial pattern but not a deeply complex attack chain.
